items.summary: Recommendation: maintain containment; admit no new spend or implementation this cycle. Supported revenue is limited to $4.92 aggregate Amazon commission for 2026-09-21 from 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, and 6 shipped items. All commission is in the unassignable aggregate row; site-attributed commission is $0. The 61-click allthingsmasonic.com baseline supports a learning test only, not a revenue forecast. September AI usage cost is $997.51762695 across 5,522 calls, or approximately $0.181 per call, but cost-to-learn is not calculable because costs are not linked to experiments, outcomes, or causal lift. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, budget variance, and fleet-level profitability are not calculable because revenue covers only 2026-09-21 while AI cost covers 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-30, and infrastructure, labor, fixed-cost, and marketing-budget amounts are absent. Minimum measurement: period-aligned site and fleet revenue, AI/infrastructure/vendor costs, allocated labor or a declared labor boundary, and experiment-level cost and outcome identifiers. Preserve the allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement only as a slot-gated reportable learning test measuring registered affiliate clicks; do not forecast revenue or conversion lift. Maintain private-launch, security, compliance, and attribution gates.

Finance attribution boundary: retain provider aggregate income as explicitly unassigned. Do not allocate the $4.92 aggregate commission or its 629 aggregate clicks to any site. Require every newly introduced affiliate link to use a registered tracking identifier; validate registry-to-link matching before treating future site revenue as attributable.

Budget exposure is not bounded: monthly_spend_limit, fixed_costs_monthly, marketing_budget_monthly, revenue_target_monthly, and revenue_floor_monthly are blank. The known September AI cost of $997.51762695 is actual usage evidence, not an approved budget or forecast. No banking, billing, contract, or spending action is authorized.

The existing allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement remains financially acceptable only as a bounded learning test after capacity clears. Baseline: 61 registered affiliate clicks, 0 ordered items, and $0 site-attributed commission for 2026-09-21. Primary metric: registered affiliate clicks on the changed surface over 14 days or 100 relevant impressions/clicks. Revenue, margin, and causal lift remain unknown.
